metaTitle: Custom Frosted Badge Reels | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom frosted badge reels for a sleek, modern look. Perfect for corporate ID badges. Bulk pricing at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Frosted badge reels offer a subtle, sophisticated alternative to standard clear or solid reels. The frosted finish diffuses light, reducing glare and giving your logo a soft, matte appearance. Ideal for healthcare, tech, or any professional setting where a clean, modern aesthetic matters. Customize with your logo using polydome charms in shapes like oval, star, heart, or square for a polished, cohesive look across your team.
heroAltText: Custom frosted badge reels with polydome charms in oval and star shapes for professional ID badges
